decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The LB of Hounslow  as the LPA hereby certify that on 23/12/2004 the  erection of a single storey outbuilding measuring 7m wide, by 4m high by 7m depth  would  have been lawful within the meaning of  Sections 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, (as amended), for the following reason: 
The proposed development would fall within Class E, Part 1, Schedule 2 of  The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order, 1995. 
Informative
The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 5 Albury Avenue and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as a gym to dwellinghouse
